title: Production is declared, never guessed: whichever declaration says production wins, and unknown is never production
goal: tierOf() reads every word Orbit accepts onto its one tier however a person writes it, and every other word onto unknown; isProduction() is true exactly for a production declaration; strictestTier() lets the strictest known declaration win, production first, and is unknown only when nothing is known; and through capabilityAction() and authorize() a capability lands where its declarations say -- in its task's sandbox when it is bound to one, on production whenever it declares production -- so a production deploy, migration, destructive operation or undeclared write asks a person, and the same anywhere else, or anywhere nobody declared, runs on its own
reproduce: every failing check names the declaration, the declarations or the capability it described, the tier or verdict the contract expects and what came back; the probe imports the subject's own modules and answers in its own process
